integrity: The two GL2 orbit types are proved from the intersection of a projective line with the binary-quadratic discriminant conic. The Euler-symmetric ideals, degrees, and cone automorphism dimensions are reconstructed exactly. A packaged symbolic verifier independently checks the equations, Hilbert-function degrees, total automorphism dimensions, and Euler-weight decompositions.
scientific_limitations: The result treats only rank-2 symbols with two-dimensional tangent space and a two-dimensional quadratic-symbol subspace. It computes infinitesimal linear automorphisms of the affine cone and the sharp Hwang–Li bounds, not full abstract automorphism groups or higher-dimensional symbol classifications.
title: A secant–tangent symmetry jump for quadratic Euler-symmetric surfaces
